package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/onboardingcontract"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const onboardingTurnBodyLimit int64 = 16 << 10

type StudentOnboardingTurnApplier interface {
	Handle(context.Context, domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingTurnGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProver interface {
	Handle(context.Context, domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
}

func (h *Handler) ApplyTeacherStudentOnboardingTurn(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingTurnApply == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding turn is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var command domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingTurnBodyLimit, &command); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding turn request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if command.StudentCommandID != r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding turn request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	command.StudentID = chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")
	result, err := h.OnboardingTurnApply.Handle(r.Context(), command)
	writeOnboardingTurnResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) GetTeacherStudentOnboardingTurn(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingTurns == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding turn is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.OnboardingTurns.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "studentCommandID"))
	writeOnboardingTurnResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) ProveTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingTurnProofs == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding turn is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var proof domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingTurnBodyLimit, &proof); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding turn no-effect proof", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	commandID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentCommandID")
	if proof.Command.StudentCommandID != commandID || commandID != r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding turn no-effect proof", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	proof.Command.StudentID = chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")
	result, err := h.OnboardingTurnProofs.Handle(r.Context(), proof)
	writeOnboardingTurnResult(w, result, err)
}

func writeOnboardingTurnResult(w http.ResponseWriter, result domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding turn request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "onboarding turn not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			http.Error(w, "onboarding turn conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
			http.Error(w, "onboarding turn capability disabled", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "onboarding turn operation failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

var _ StudentOnboardingTurnApplier = studentuc.ApplyStudentOnboardingTurn{}
var _ StudentOnboardingTurnGetter = studentuc.GetStudentOnboardingTurn{}
var _ StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProver = studentuc.ProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect{}
